description: For each Shopify store: name, city and country, currency, product and collection counts, a catalog snapshot (price range and median, share on sale and in stock, top brands and product types, newest product) and its e-mails, phones and social profiles. Non-Shopify sites are skipped for free. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/shopify-store-analyzer on your Apify account (about $0.004 per store; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

countries.description: Keep only stores based in these countries (ISO codes or names).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

include_contacts.description: Also read the store's contact pages for e-mails, phones and socials.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 20, max 1000). Cost scales with this.

name: analyze_shopify_stores

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Analyze Shopify stores (location, catalog, contacts)
